name: Use the recipe tree to see the whole project

pages.text: The installed recipe-tree view helps you trace an item back through its ingredients. Use it to find the part of the project that your workshop cannot yet produce.

For example, a machine might need a circuit, the circuit might need a board, and the board might need a chemical you have never made. Your next project is the chemical supply. Once that supply works, the rest of the chain becomes much easier to follow.
Where the tree offers alternative recipes, choose routes that match your equipment and resources. Check the underlying recipe before committing to a large ingredient list.
